Table 2 summarizes metric and scalar rejection rates across population models.

```{r table2, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(knitr)

table2_cell <- readRDS(
  "C:/Users/Leonie.Hagitte/Desktop/gh/SEMi/future_build/results/table2_condition_specific.rds"
)

cat("\\begingroup\n")
cat("\\centering\n")
cat("\\small\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}\n")

cat(
  knitr::kable(
    table2_cell,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = TRUE,
    align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r", rep("c", ncol(table2_cell) - 5)),
    caption = paste(
      "Condition-specific rejection rates for metric and scalar",
      "measurement invariance across population models, sample sizes,",
      "moderator specifications, and effect sizes.",
      "Monte Carlo standard errors are given in parentheses."
    ),
    label = "tab:condition-performance"
  )
)

cat("\\endgroup\n")
```
